name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 7 visits over 78 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.3 days starting 2026-05-04, at wavelengths from 0.89 to 4.54 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
